page.layout: One printed page. A centred heading "INDEX." at the top. Below it, two parallel columns of index entries: left column from "Finni" to "Vasco de Gama", right column from "Orientalem" to "Granada". At the foot, the gathering signature "G 5" at left and the catchword "Gra-" at right, below the last line of the right column. No running head and no page number. The left-page edge is excluded.
page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Getleh" (first word of the G entries) is uncertain; the printed letters are set in a damaged-looking type. The page numbers printed as "zz", "8z", "86" and "IIO" are doubtful and are marked [?] or copied as printed. "Barbaroffa" is printed with a double-s ligature; written as Barbarossa. "Gothorum regna in Hi-spaniæ" and "Glogovienfis Dux Hein-ricus" are line-end hyphenations kept as printed. No marginal notes, no running head, no page number.
